valores.label: Widening of the existing Glacier Highway (Echo Cove to Cascade Point)
New ferry terminal, north of the Katzehin River by

legenda: Alternative 2B: East Lynn Canal Highway from Echo Cove to a ferry terminal north of the Katzehin River, with ferries to Haines and Skagway.
narracao: Highway officials chose a version of that route in 2006. It stopped short of Haines and Skagway, so drivers would finish the trip on a ferry.

conferencia.prova: "In April 2006, FHWA issued a Record of Decision (ROD) … stating that DOT&PF and FHWA selected Alternative 2B for design and construction."

conferencia.item: 50,8 mi (47,9 + 2,9); Echo Cove; 2 mi ao norte do Katzehin
conferencia.prova: "Alternative 2B would construct the East Lynn Canal Highway from Echo Cove to a new ferry terminal 2 miles north of the Katzehin River, with ferry service connecting Katzehin to Haines and Skagway… The highway would be 50.8 miles long, including 47.9 miles of new highway and widening of 2.9 miles of the existing Glacier Highway from Echo Cove to Cascade Point."
